title: Military Referral Management Review for Active Duty Service Members, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
For an active duty service member, every civilian specialty, therapy and inpatient request under **Referrals and Authorizations** goes first to military clinic referral management where the type requires that review, and, for a TRICARE Prime Remote service member, to the service point of contact where the type requires that review; the region approves only after that review.

## Point-of-service

Active duty service members have no point-of-service option. Care they receive without the required authorization is referred to the military medical support office, not cost-shared.

## Points of judgement

| Patient | Type requires the review | Review the request goes through | When the region may approve |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active duty service member, civilian specialty, therapy or inpatient request | military clinic referral management review required | military clinic referral management | only after that review |
| TRICARE Prime Remote service member | service point-of-contact review required | the service point of contact | only after that review |

| Care received by an active duty service member | Treatment |
|---|---|
| without the required authorization | referred to the military medical support office; not cost-shared |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An active duty service member's PCM requests a civilian Specialty Care Referral to a network orthopedist. The request goes to military clinic referral management first, and the region approves it only after that review.
